title: Plantago major tincture for medicinal use
intro: Plantago major tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the leaves of the common plantain plant. It is prepared by soaking the dried leaves in alcohol to extract their medicinal properties. This tincture is widely used in herbalism for its anti-inflammatory, astringent, and wound-healing properties. It is often applied topically to treat skin irritations, insect bites, and minor wounds. In some cases, it may also be taken internally to support digestive health and reduce inflammation.
